BREAKING: Starlink is supporting Project SPARROW's biodiversity research in Colombia. 🇨🇴🛰️

• Starlink provides connectivity to scientists working in remote regions.
• AI-powered analysis is helping researchers identify wildlife activity and discover new animal behaviors.
• Tasks that once took thousands of hours of manual review can now be completed far more efficiently.
• The project is accelerating conservation efforts through faster access to environmental data.

Starlink is helping bring AI-powered research to some of the world's most remote ecosystems.

URSYS has launched a Layer 2 secure Starlink solution for remote connectivity in Australia. 🇦🇺

• Connects remote Starlink terminals directly to private corporate networks.
• Keeps sensitive SCADA, telemetry, and operational data off the public internet.
• Designed for secure, enterprise-grade connectivity in remote locations.

The new solution expands Starlink's capabilities for businesses operating critical infrastructure and industrial networks.

NEWS: Tesla's momentum in Canada continues to accelerate. 🇨🇦

• Model Y sales nearly doubled in Q2 2026, rising 98%.
• Tesla delivered an estimated 5,765 vehicles, up 28.1% year over year.
• First-half Model Y sales climbed to 8,390, marking a 79.8% increase.
• Cybertruck deliveries surged 116.4%, reaching 725 units.

With strong growth across multiple models, Tesla is continuing to strengthen its position in the Canadian EV market.
